uncertainty: Whether the fixed normal-mouse host plan wins PILOT-VICTORY depends on combat pacing I cannot replay here: all numeric costs/HP/speeds/timings are frozen by the requirements, while the contact distance (62), projectile hit radius (46), sprite scale and shooter attack-flash window are implementation choices, so the balance outcome must be confirmed by host acceptance.

The media manifest is consumed as an authoring input and its exact registered paths/fps are encoded in media.ts; I deliberately do not fetch /assets/manifest.json at runtime (avoids adding a same-origin request that could 404 and pollute the no-missing-resource check). If the reviewer requires a runtime manifest fetch, that is a change this role would need to make.
